scope: Each of the 310 concepts is adjudicated against the actual operation and observable fields. Omitted names remain specific-practice PENDING; a family or a runnable unrelated command cannot close the gap.

observations.basis: The exact source coalesces five async callers through a local mutex and a shared task; cancellation and producer call counts are asserted.
The exact historical source starts refresh at 0.6 while the TTL ends at 1.0; the refreshed value is available at 1.05.
The same civil-date wire value is interpreted at the frontend boundary, and remains distinct from a timestamp.
The historical function preserves OPP identity, refuses won/lost states and contrasts per-request keys with a per-entity claim.
Repeated deliveries are explicit inputs. The local effect must remain two operations and a debit of 150. Exactly-once refers only to this finite effect counter.
SQLite atomically records the message key and debit; duplicate consumption leaves two inbox rows, two effects and debit 150.
A crash window loses the second independent write; one local transaction preserves the order and its outbox intention.
The local orchestrator debits, encounters a failed allocation and conditionally issues an offsetting credit.
The version expected by a stale writer differs from the committed version; the reread preserves the earlier credit.
The destination compares ordered generations 101 and 102 and rejects the delayed lower generation.
Two actors target the same advisor/slot key; only one local claim is admitted.
The finite partition model tests a necessary majority-authority property, not either complete protocol; minority writes remain zero.
Two reads and two writes among three members have at least one common member; intersection does not alone prove linearizability.
Incomparable vectors expose two concurrent branches before their pointwise merge.
Receiving clock 8 at clock 3 advances the receiver to 9; no wall-clock claim is made.
A prepared participant lacking the coordinator decision remains uncertain; it cannot guess commit after a local timeout. This tests the blocking condition only.
Equal peers exchange membership sets repeatedly and all three converge; no majority decision is involved.
A request routed to another process loses local session state; an external session owner makes both instances resolve the same user.
A primary update precedes replica application; the older replica read changes only after replay of that update.
The session requires the version it already observed or wrote, rejecting a route to an older replica.
Six typed messages are routed to two destinations, enriched with an account and counted by destination.
The negative-amount message is removed; two valid messages remain, totaling 150.
One envelope becomes two individual order messages with the same batch correlation and amount total 150.

observations.names: Retry|Retry Queue|Dead Letter Queue|Poison Message Handling|Message Queue|Job Queue
observations.basis: A deque is consumed, poison is re-enqueued with a budget, and its third failure routes it to a separate collection.
A heap selects urgent before standard and low, changing the actual processing order.
A not-before threshold prevents dispatch at clock 3 and allows it at clock 5.
The finite-capacity admission decision accepts 20 and explicitly rejects 100 of 120 requests.
The producer advances only when the consumer creates capacity; all six tasks finish without rejection and the buffer stays at two.
The controlled clock enforces at most two admitted requests in each window, independently of buffer capacity. Throttling here uses rejection, not delayed pacing.
Unique tasks are assigned once to one of two consumers; this is work division, not broadcast.
Both audit and risk subscriptions actually receive both events, totaling four deliveries rather than two divided tasks.
An ID-only notification requires a source lookup; the carried-state payload provides the fields this consumer needs with zero lookups.
Known sequence metadata restores accepted/reserved/settled order and the transition guard rejects settled as the initial transition.
The model computes delays 1/2/4, adds fixed learning jitter and opens its circuit after the third failure, refusing further iterations.
A real asyncio wait on an unset event ends in TimeoutError within the configured bound.
The child receives the remaining three units of its parent's deadline instead of a fresh ten-unit budget.
The dependency loop makes transform eligible after extract and publish after transform; no durable engine is claimed.
The first miss loads and stores the source value; two subsequent hits avoid additional source calls.
A distinct cached-absence sentinel suppresses the second and third source lookups for a nonexistent key.
A preloaded position removes the first request-path source fetch.
A value with expiration 10 is rejected at clock 11 and the decision returns to its producer.
The local copy is removed and reloaded from the owner; both levels then hold value 2.
The simulated crash discards buffered memory and contrasts the acknowledged durable balance in each write order.
Three financial facts are replayed as the source of the resulting balance 900; the event history is preserved in the fixture.
The command handler validates and updates one model, while a separate query handler exposes a projection contract with an observable lag and catch-up.
The materialized position advances by two missing events from 1000 to 900; the query value is computed ahead of its later read.
The position-2 snapshot plus the remaining debit reconstructs 900 with one event rather than three.
SQLite reports WAL mode and rollback preserves the prior committed cents. This is not PostgreSQL WAL recovery or a formal log-before-page-write trace.
A modulo ownership rule divides rows by key and routes key 7 to one of three logical partitions.
The actual virtual-node ring reassigns only the keys whose successor becomes the new node, contrasting the modulo remap count.
The SQLite query plan changes from SCAN to SEARCH USING COVERING INDEX after adding the key-and-value index.
The old reader loses amount when it is removed; the expanded representation preserves both reader contracts.
The primary result remains visible while a pure shadow computation executes and exposes the result mismatch; no side effect is delegated to the shadow.
Stable A/B cohorts actually receive different user-visible responses, rather than only running a hidden shadow.
A traffic predicate selects five of 100 requests for the new version and preserves an old route for rollback.
The fixture evaluates role, tenant attributes and the relationship to the specific account, rejecting the cross-tenant object.
The verifier rejects the expired credential and wrong audience. Signature authentication remains outside this unsigned claims model.
An explicit allowed-edge model rejects direct browser access to the ledger in addition to the object policy; no live firewall is claimed.
Structured records carry separate request and operation identities, allowing three spans from two attempts to be correlated in one collected set.
The calculation uses request grain: three spans, two requests, one operation and one failed request; request error ratio is 1/2.
The process-level health result is compared to the controlled business-path result; healthy process does not imply a successful order path.
The frozen monetary type rejects negative construction, compares values by components and prevents mutation.
An actual provider message is transformed into the consumer schema, renaming fields and converting cents into BRL.
The cache read API invokes and stores a loader result; the caller only uses that cache API.
The adapter translates external AUTHORISED and integer cents into the local accepted state and BRL amount before domain processing.
The local authorization-code model binds verifier and redirect, permits one code redemption and issues an audience/scope-limited signed access token.
observations.action: Troque o código por token usando o verificador PKCE e a redirect URI vinculada. Antes da troca válida, tente os dois valores errados; depois tente reutilizar o código.
observations.scope_limit: A teaching model of RFC 6749/7636 message checks; it is not an authorization-server library, browser login, refresh flow or production OAuth security implementation.

observations.basis: The ID-token validation property checks issuer, audience, nonce, expiration and the configured HS256 signature before accepting the subject.
observations.action: Valide o ID token assinado e repita com nonce diferente, audience diferente e assinatura alterada. Confira que conhecer um sub no JSON não basta para aceitar a identidade.
observations.scope_limit: The synthetic client uses a preconfigured shared key. Discovery, JWKS, key negotiation, all claim rules and an actual OpenID Provider are not implemented.

observations.basis: A signed credential remains valid through the overlap and becomes inadmissible after its signing key is removed from trust.
observations.action: Emita tokens com old e new, aceite ambos na janela de sobreposição e retire old do verificador. Confira a validação criptográfica, a recusa do token antigo e a recusa da assinatura alterada.
observations.scope_limit: Keys are fixed synthetic HMAC material. Secret storage, asymmetric key distribution and coordinated live-service rotation are outside the experiment.

observations.basis: The resource authenticates a signed service principal and validates its intended audience/scope rather than trusting a caller-supplied service label.
observations.action: Autentique o cliente de serviço antes de emitir a credencial e valide sua assinatura no recurso. Compare com aceitar um nome de serviço apenas declarado pelo chamador.
observations.scope_limit: Client secrets and tokens are synthetic; there is no real identity provider, protected key store or live service deployment.

observations.basis: The exchanged credential is bound to the target resource and a narrower delegated scope, preserving subject and actor identities.
observations.action: Valide o token destinado ao gateway e troque-o por uma credencial mais curta para order-api. Confira o usuário preservado, o ator do serviço e a redução de escopo.
observations.scope_limit: This is an RFC 8693-style claim transformation model, without a token-exchange endpoint or a complete delegation authorization policy.

observations.basis: Network location does not replace per-request identity and resource-policy verification in the tested boundary.
observations.action: Marque os dois pedidos como internos. Recuse o serviço rogue mesmo com token assinado válido e aceite somente o principal e a permissão esperados para o recurso.
observations.scope_limit: This demonstrates one zero-trust access property, not an organization-wide zero-trust architecture, device posture or continuous risk engine.

observations.basis: Administrative access is funneled through an authenticated jump boundary and direct access to the protected target is denied.
observations.action: Tente o acesso administrativo direto e depois os dois saltos permitidos via bastion. Repita o primeiro salto com uma pessoa sem papel administrativo.
observations.scope_limit: The graph executes authorization and routing decisions, not SSH, a real bastion host, firewall rules or session recording.

observations.basis: Real SSLContext handshakes reject a client missing its certificate when mutual verification is required and authenticate both trusted peers before exchanging data.
observations.action: Execute três handshakes TLS por socketpair: servidor sem exigir cliente, servidor exigindo cliente ausente e cliente com certificado confiável. Confira a autenticação dos dois pares e a troca de ORDER-1.
observations.scope_limit: Certificates and keys are generated only in a temporary directory and removed. No listening port, external connection, production CA or service configuration is changed.

observations.basis: Different logical workers use the same partition owner and share its populated cache entry, unlike independent per-worker caches.
observations.action: Faça dois workers lógicos consultarem a mesma posição pelo dono da chave no cache compartilhado. Confira que a segunda leitura não volta à fonte.
observations.scope_limit: The owners are local dictionaries; the experiment isolates shared-owner cache semantics without claiming a networked cache product or cross-machine durability.

observations.basis: A prepare quorum reports accepted values; the proposer carries the value at the highest accepted ballot rather than inventing a different value.
observations.action: Prepare a rodada 8 em dois acceptors que já aceitaram ORDER-A na rodada 7. Proponha ORDER-B e confira por que o novo proposer precisa carregar o valor previamente aceito.
observations.scope_limit: A finite single-decree Paxos schedule with reliable local messages; persistence, liveness and arbitrary faults are not implemented.

observations.basis: The follower checks the previous index/term before appending; a retry from a matching prefix replaces conflicting suffix entries.
observations.action: Envie AppendEntries com prevLogIndex=2 e prevLogTerm=3 para uma réplica cujo termo no índice 2 é 2. Confira a recusa e a repetição a partir do prefixo comum.
observations.scope_limit: This isolates Raft log matching, without election, durable storage, commitment or a complete replicated state machine.

observations.basis: A voter remembers its vote in the term and refuses a second different candidate in that term.
observations.action: Faça B votar em A no termo 2 e depois receber C no mesmo termo. Confira que B não vota nos dois candidatos e que só A reúne a maioria.
observations.scope_limit: The fixture does not implement log freshness, randomized timeouts, persistence or all election transitions.

observations.basis: The extra precommit state distinguishes the modeled 3PC decision from an uncertain 2PC prepare, under the explicit timing and no-partition assumptions.
observations.action: Faça os dois participantes reconhecerem canCommit e preCommit. Compare a decisão no modelo síncrono declarado com o caso em que uma partição ainda é possível.
observations.scope_limit: This is not a partition-tolerant atomic commit implementation; the autonomous commit decision is not generalized outside those assumptions.

observations.basis: The receive rule combines the physical maximum with a logical counter when the received wall component wins.
observations.action: Receba o evento 1010:3 com relógio físico em 1005 e relógio local em 1006:1. Confira a parte física máxima e o contador lógico que conserva a ordem causal.
observations.scope_limit: The one receive schedule does not synchronize physical clocks or prove a distributed implementation under every skew pattern.

observations.basis: The writer acknowledgement is ordered after this replica applies the write, providing the tested after-ack visibility property.
observations.action: Mantenha a réplica na versão 1 enquanto o primário está na 2. Confira que a confirmação sincronizada espera a aplicação e que a leitura dessa réplica após a confirmação vê a versão 2.
observations.scope_limit: This bounded primary/replica schedule does not alone prove linearizability, all replica routing or consistency under partitions.

observations.basis: Replication follows A to B to C, exposing the intermediate replica as the source of the final replica.
observations.action: Aplique a versão de A em B e só depois replique B em C. Observe que C depende do intermediário, em vez de consultar diretamente A.
observations.scope_limit: The model has one ordered update, no WAL streams, failover or network delay.

observations.basis: Both sites accept writes and reconciliation preserves distinct additive credits instead of choosing one absolute snapshot.
observations.action: Aceite um crédito distinto em A e B. Compare a última substituição absoluta de saldo com a reconciliação das identidades dos dois créditos.
observations.scope_limit: This merge is valid only for the declared independent credits; noncommutative debits and invariants need a business conflict policy.

observations.basis: Every read in this single-owner schedule observes the latest preceding completed write, independently of a client session hint.
observations.action: Leia 1.000, conclua o crédito de 100 no dono serializado e faça outra leitura sem carregar um token de sessão. Confira a versão e a ordem das operações no histórico.
observations.scope_limit: This is one serialized-owner history, not a universal linearizability proof or a distributed strong-consistency system under failures.

observations.basis: Standby readiness changes the restore/start/catch-up work required before the role transition.
observations.action: Recupere a mesma versão com uma cópia fria, uma morna e uma quente. Execute os passos que faltam em cada uma antes de promover seu papel para primário.
observations.scope_limit: The steps are state transitions in a finite model, not measured RTO, restored backups or real database promotion.

observations.basis: A failure detector based on heartbeat age triggers the modeled role transition automatically.
observations.action: Avance o relógio de 0 para 6 com prazo 5, detecte o heartbeat antigo e promova a cópia que já alcançou a versão necessária.
observations.scope_limit: A timeout suspects failure; this local model does not prove the old primary stopped or supply fencing under a network partition.

observations.basis: Replica placement across different failure domains leaves one instance after the declared zone or region outage.
observations.action: Distribua as duas instâncias entre zonas e regiões distintas e remova uma zona ou região inteira. Compare as instâncias que sobrevivem aos mesmos domínios de falha.
observations.scope_limit: Replication freshness, routing, shared dependencies, quorum and regulatory placement are not inferred from the survivor count.

observations.basis: The sample distinguishes healthy process status from traffic/latency/errors/saturation and from resource utilization/saturation/errors.
observations.action: Mantenha o processo saudável enquanto as duas vagas estão ocupadas e três pedidos aguardam. Calcule tráfego, duração, erros, utilização e saturação em seus grãos declarados.
observations.scope_limit: These are controlled sample measurements, not production percentiles, SLOs or a capacity benchmark.

observations.basis: The real SDK exports two parent/child spans in one trace, propagates context and records one failed span for one request.
observations.action: Execute o SDK OpenTelemetry fixado, injete e extraia traceparent entre gateway e provider e exporte para memória. Confira o mesmo trace, o parent span e o erro, sem confundir dois spans com duas requisições.
observations.scope_limit: The exporter is in memory with SDK 1.45.1. There is no collector, network service or claim of production instrumentation.

observations.basis: The controller changes the model and selects a view; the view renders a DTO and never owns the write.
observations.action: Execute o crédito pelo controlador e confira que a apresentação recebe apenas os dados finais, sem realizar a escrita do modelo.
observations.scope_limit: A local role model; routing, templates and a web framework are not implemented.

observations.basis: The presenter loads and prepares the model result; a passive view only receives the display value.
observations.action: Substitua a view por uma lista que recebe chamadas do presenter. Confira quem lê o modelo e quem transforma a informação para apresentação.
observations.scope_limit: The recording view models the interface boundary rather than a full UI toolkit.

observations.basis: A binding propagates an observable view-model property change into the view.
observations.action: Altere a propriedade balance do view model e observe o callback de binding atualizar a apresentação sem uma chamada explícita de renderização no comando.
observations.scope_limit: The model covers one-way binding; validation, two-way binding and UI lifecycle remain outside it.

observations.basis: Each agent owns abstraction, presentation and control; parent control coordinates the child agents.
observations.action: Faça dois controles filhos atualizarem suas abstrações e peça ao controle pai para compor o total. Compare com a última escrita isolada de uma apresentação compartilhada.
observations.scope_limit: This is a small hierarchical PAC model, not a recommendation to adopt PAC in MakersHub.

observations.names: Layered / N-Tier|Clean Architecture|Onion Architecture|Hexagonal / Ports & Adapters
observations.basis: Ordered invocation exhibits layers; the domain depends on its port and two replaceable adapters implement that port, exhibiting the inward dependency property of Clean/Onion/Hexagonal designs.
observations.action: Siga presentation, application e domain e troque a implementação da porta de gravação entre dois adaptadores. Confira a regra e os imports do domínio.
observations.scope_limit: Only these boundary properties are modeled. The four styles have further distinctions not erased by sharing the exercise.

observations.basis: Public component contracts separate modules in one process; the order feature groups the steps of one vertical use case.
observations.action: Execute a ordem pelo contrato público do módulo e atualize posições pelo contrato do outro módulo. Examine o agrupamento da validação, do handler e da persistência na fatia de ordens.
observations.scope_limit: The model demonstrates module and feature boundaries, not automatic proof of a repository-wide architecture.

observations.basis: A stable kernel invokes a registered extension through a shared contract.
observations.action: Registre um plugin premium no catálogo e execute a política pelo contrato já usado pelo núcleo. Confira que o dispatcher não ganha um novo condicional.
observations.scope_limit: Isolation, signing, lifecycle and dependency policy of untrusted plugins are not implemented.

observations.basis: Independent specialists read and contribute to a shared problem state until their prerequisites become available.
observations.action: Execute os especialistas na ordem em que alocação tenta agir antes de risco. Observe o quadro de fatos permitir que a próxima rodada conclua a alocação.
observations.scope_limit: The fixture has monotonic facts and two rounds; conflict resolution and an unrestricted expert scheduler are outside it.

observations.basis: A private state owner serializes messages and provides a single writer for this actor.
observations.action: Envie dois incrementos ao ator e deixe somente seu consumidor de mailbox escrever o estado. Compare com dois leitores que gravam a partir do mesmo valor antigo.
observations.scope_limit: The mailbox is local; supervision, distributed actors and message durability are not claimed.

observations.basis: The producer emits a fact and a subscribed handler reacts to it asynchronously in the local schedule.
observations.action: Aceite o crédito no produtor e observe a projeção só avançar quando seu handler recebe o evento. Inspecione que o produtor não chama a projeção diretamente.
observations.scope_limit: Transport, delivery guarantees and cross-process execution are not part of this event-driven property model.

observations.basis: An explicit business service owns its store and operation contract; the other service failure does not mutate or prevent its operation in this controlled schedule.
observations.action: Execute o mesmo contrato de conta por duas operações e provoque uma falha no serviço vizinho. Confira que a leitura do dono da conta continua independente.
observations.scope_limit: Services are logical local participants. Network independence, deployment, discovery and distributed transactions are not proven.

observations.basis: The handler tolerates fresh invocation memory and keeps authoritative state outside that ephemeral environment.
observations.action: Inicie cada invocação com memória local nova e conserve o crédito pela porta externa. Confira que a segunda invocação vê 1.100 sem depender de um processo aquecido.
observations.scope_limit: No cloud runtime, billing, autoscaling or vendor-specific execution contract is simulated.

observations.basis: A partitioned memory grid owns data and co-locates processing; the same owner partitions can serve shared cache reads to different logical workers.
observations.action: Distribua as doze entradas pelo dono da chave e execute a alteração dentro de cada partição em memória. Confira a distribuição e a soma sem consultar um banco central.
observations.scope_limit: The grid is a finite local model, without durable replication, network partitions or a deployed distributed-cache product.

observations.basis: Independent cells contain one failure while the other cell completes its own request.
observations.action: Provoque a falha da célula A e continue o pedido destinado à célula B. Confira que a recuperação não redireciona silenciosamente dados de A para B.
observations.scope_limit: Capacity, routing safety, replication and failover between real regions remain outside this local failure-boundary experiment.

observations.basis: The root owns the public mutation operation and checks the invariant spanning its children before accepting the next item.
observations.action: Tente acrescentar 50 e 80 a uma cesta com limite 100. Compare a escrita direta dos filhos com a única entrada pública da raiz, que preserva o total válido.
observations.scope_limit: The aggregate is in memory; Python private attributes are a convention and distributed transaction boundaries are not established.

observations.basis: A domain operation involving two entities preserves the stated transfer invariant without belonging naturally to either entity alone.
observations.action: Transfira 100 entre duas entidades pelo serviço de domínio e confira a conservação do total, em vez de creditar o destino isoladamente.
observations.scope_limit: Only an in-memory operation is executed; durable atomic transfer, fees and real financial rules are not claimed.

observations.basis: The repository presents a domain collection contract while storage representation changes behind it.
observations.action: Troque o armazenamento entre dicionário e lista de linhas mantendo get/save e a entidade Account usados pela operação. Confira 1.100 nas duas implementações.
observations.scope_limit: The adapters are local fakes, without SQL mapping, identity maps or unit-of-work concurrency.

observations.basis: The application service coordinates the use case and calls domain behavior before persistence instead of embedding a write before validation.
observations.action: Envie um comando inválido ao serviço de aplicação. Siga carregamento, validação e rejeição e confira que ele não manda persistir uma operação recusada.
observations.scope_limit: The ordering model does not supply an ORM transaction, authentication or a production application layer.

observations.basis: A factory centralizes the valid construction of the domain object and rejects invalid combinations.
observations.action: Construa a transferência pela fábrica e tente repetir com valor negativo. Confira que uma transferência inválida não chega a existir pelo contrato público.
observations.scope_limit: The construction rule belongs only to this hypothetical transfer fixture.

observations.basis: One named criterion is reused across selection and validation, eliminating the duplicated inconsistent predicate in this fixture.
observations.action: Aplique a mesma specification na seleção e na validação das três contas fictícias. Confira que a conta inativa deixa de aparecer como candidata em apenas um caminho.
observations.scope_limit: The threshold is a synthetic teaching rule, not an advisor or customer eligibility rule from Faz.

observations.basis: An actual schema change exposes affected consumers; bounded contexts give available different meanings, and the supplier/consumer agreement restores explicit contracts and a shared vocabulary within each context.
observations.action: Altere o contrato do fornecedor de available para settled_balance e reserved_balance. Execute os dois consumidores, identifique os quebrados no mapa e adapte os significados de disponibilidade em cada contexto.
observations.scope_limit: The context map and language belong to this hypothetical business exercise. They do not assert the canonical Faz glossary or a historical organizational decision.

observations.basis: The downstream deliberately adopts the upstream vocabulary and schema, including its coupling cost.
observations.action: Adapte o consumidor para usar diretamente provider_state=AUTHORISED, sem criar tradução local. Compare essa escolha com o adaptador semântico do caso anterior.
observations.scope_limit: The exercise demonstrates the relationship choice, not a recommendation to accept every provider concept.

observations.basis: Choosing separate ways prevents an unrelated context from inheriting the other context change through a shared mutable object.
observations.action: Mude a política de taxa de um contexto e execute o outro. Compare o objeto compartilhado acidentalmente com contratos independentes sem integração.
observations.scope_limit: Duplication has a maintenance cost; this fixture does not decide the real organizational boundary.

observations.basis: The shared kernel makes a small domain rule genuinely shared and exposes the joint impact of changing it.
observations.action: Execute os dois consumidores com a mesma regra compartilhada e altere o arredondamento do kernel. Observe que ambos mudam e precisam do mesmo acordo de versão.
observations.scope_limit: The rounding is synthetic. Joint ownership and release coordination are required rather than inferred from a common helper.

observations.basis: A stable public service contract supports multiple consumers while internal representation changes behind it.
observations.action: Altere o armazenamento interno para settled_cents e mantenha uma operação pública versionada para os dois clientes. Confira que a forma interna não vaza para o contrato público.
observations.scope_limit: Version governance, authentication and remote transport are not provided by this local contract exercise.

observations.basis: Resource paths, method semantics and response status are explicit; GET does not become an operation that writes.
observations.action: Leia o recurso por GET, crie outro por POST e tente um método não atendido. Confira a ausência de escrita no GET e os códigos 200, 201 e 405.
observations.scope_limit: Requests are local dictionaries and function calls, without an HTTP server, caching intermediaries or complete REST constraints.

observations.basis: The dispatcher invokes an explicit operation and returns its result to the matching requester.
observations.action: Envie a operação reserve com seus parâmetros e correlacione a resposta com REQUEST-1. Diferencie esse contrato por operação da rota de recurso do exercício REST.
observations.scope_limit: The finite request/reply dispatcher does not implement a remote transport, deadlines or an RPC framework.

observations.names: API Gateway|Gateway Routing|Gateway Offloading|Reverse Proxy|API Gateway Security
observations.basis: The entry point routes requests, offloads authentication checks and forwards the accepted method/payload to the selected backend.
observations.action: Tente uma chamada sem permissão e depois chamadas para ordens e posições. Confira que o gateway recusa antes do backend, escolhe a rota e preserva método, corpo e resposta no encaminhamento.
observations.scope_limit: This models gateway/proxy properties, not a deployed reverse proxy, token verification, TLS termination or every HTTP forwarding rule.

observations.basis: A server-side composition calls two owners and returns a client-specific view, reducing client round trips without pretending the backend calls disappear.
observations.action: Monte a mesma visão a partir de posição e ordens para web e mobile. Observe uma chamada do cliente e os formatos distintos preparados no servidor.
observations.scope_limit: Partial failures, freshness and authorization of each constituent service need separate contracts.

observations.basis: Entity-reference resolution joins fields owned by different subgraphs through the declared entity key instead of a display label.
observations.action: Passe a representação da entidade Account com sua chave aos dois subgraphs lógicos e componha balance e open_orders pelo mesmo identificador.
observations.scope_limit: This is the entity-key resolution property of federation. It does not include a GraphQL parser, supergraph schema, query planner or Apollo runtime.

observations.basis: The representation exposes state-dependent action links and the client follows an available relation rather than hardcoding every transition.
observations.action: Mude a ordem de accepted para settled e deixe o cliente procurar a relação cancel na representação recebida. Confira que ele não inventa uma ação que o servidor deixou de oferecer.
observations.scope_limit: The exercise covers one affordance and not an entire hypermedia API or authorization policy.

observations.basis: Polling issues repeated requests; long polling holds one request until the result becomes available.
observations.action: Consulte três vezes até a posição existir e compare com uma requisição que aguarda o evento de atualização antes de responder.
observations.scope_limit: The wait uses a local asyncio event, with no HTTP timeout, intermediary buffering or reconnect loop.

observations.basis: SSE event records carry IDs and data; a server can honor the last received ID when selecting the resumed stream.
observations.action: Codifique e leia registros id/event/data, desconecte depois do id 1 e retome com esse cursor. Confira que somente o id 2 é entregue de novo ao cliente.
observations.scope_limit: The record parser is local. HTTP streaming, browser EventSource, retry timing and proxy behavior are not executed.

observations.basis: Two independent text-frame directions share the duplex model; client frames are masked and server frames are decoded without a new poll.
observations.action: Envie um frame de texto mascarado do cliente e um frame independente do servidor. Decodifique os dois sentidos sem criar uma nova consulta para a mensagem do servidor.
observations.scope_limit: Only small unfragmented text frames are modeled, without the HTTP upgrade handshake, extensions, control frames or a production WebSocket implementation.

observations.basis: The provider pushes the event to a callback; signature verification precedes the receiver effect and the event identity suppresses a repeat.
observations.action: Receba o callback assinado, repita a mesma entrega e altere a assinatura. Confira um único efeito e a recusa 401 da mensagem que não passa na verificação.
observations.scope_limit: All keys and payloads are synthetic. Timestamp replay windows, secret distribution, TLS and a live callback server are not implemented.

observations.basis: A companion outbound proxy adds transport policy and identity; distributing the same policy to both companion proxies exhibits one mesh control/data-plane property.
observations.action: Faça cada workload usar seu proxy de saída. Atualize a política nos dois proxies e confira identidade, versão e resposta sem alterar a operação de negócio.
observations.scope_limit: The proxies are logical local companions, not separate pods or a deployed service mesh. mTLS has its own distinct experiment.

observations.basis: Try holds resources; Confirm consumes the hold, while Cancel releases the same held resources.
observations.action: Reserve dinheiro e unidade na fase Try. Siga uma cópia pela confirmação e outra pelo cancelamento; confira quais recursos ficam disponíveis em cada caminho.
observations.scope_limit: The two local outcomes model one reservation contract; distributed recovery, timeout races and idempotent callbacks remain separate obligations.

observations.basis: At most one attempt avoids repeat delivery in this fixture but can lose the operation entirely.
observations.action: Perdida a confirmação, compare repetir sem deduplicação com fazer somente uma tentativa. Depois perca a própria entrega e observe que nenhuma tentativa adicional a recupera.
observations.scope_limit: This is a sender-attempt model, not a broker delivery guarantee or proof of the external effect.

observations.names: Change Data Capture (CDC)|CDC Migration|Dual Write Migration
observations.basis: A database trigger captures only the committed after-image visible to the feed reader, allowing a destination to catch up instead of relying on a second independent application write.
observations.action: Atualize a origem dentro de uma transação que faz rollback e depois numa que faz commit. Leia o feed capturado e aplique o valor no destino da migração.
observations.scope_limit: Trigger-based CDC in SQLite is not WAL decoding, Debezium or a cross-database atomic transaction; cutover still requires reconciliation.

observations.basis: The transactional outbox is the captured table, and its committed insert becomes the CDC feed item.
observations.action: Grave a ordem e a outbox na mesma transação e acompanhe o capturador da outbox gerar EVENT-1 no feed com uma posição de retomada.
observations.scope_limit: The learning connector is a SQLite trigger plus feed query; transport, source-log offsets and recipient deduplication are not implemented.

observations.basis: Retry after an ambiguous acknowledgement restores acknowledgement while admitting repeat delivery of the same event.
observations.action: Entregue EVENT-1 e perca somente sua confirmação. Repita até receber a confirmação e conte as duas entregas da mesma identidade.
observations.scope_limit: Only this bounded acknowledgement-loss schedule is modeled; an exactly-once effect still needs the recipient transaction or idempotency mechanism.

observations.basis: A saturated dependency consumes only its own budget; the independent order pool retains capacity.
observations.action: Ocupe as duas vagas de cotações e tente executar uma ordem. Compare o pool global com os pools independentes de cotações e ordens.
observations.scope_limit: The actual semaphore admissions are local. Memory, CPU and cross-process resource isolation require additional budgets.

observations.basis: The supervisor detects the failed local state and rearms it through a replacement generation.
observations.action: Pare o serviço lógico e execute a supervisão. Confira que ela cria uma nova geração e que a leitura de saúde volta a responder.
observations.scope_limit: It is a finite restart model, without a real container, crash loop budget or a guarantee that every restart repairs the underlying cause.

observations.basis: The fallback preserves a deliberately reduced read function and labels the stale result instead of silently claiming full service.
observations.action: Provoque o timeout da fonte atual. Confira que a consulta limitada usa o último valor conhecido, sinaliza que ele não é atual e desabilita operações que exigiriam a informação fresca.
observations.scope_limit: The cached value is synthetic; the acceptable age and permitted actions need the actual product contract.

observations.basis: A declared steady-state invariant is observed before/after an intentional fault and recovery experiment.
observations.action: Declare uma ordem e um efeito como estado esperado, injete a perda da primeira entrega e execute a recuperação com repetição. Confira a violação inicial e a recuperação sem débito duplicado.
observations.scope_limit: The fault is injected only in a controlled local model, not in a production system or distributed chaos platform.

observations.basis: An ordered event log and an explicit consumer position let the consumer resume the remaining events.
observations.action: Consuma o offset 0, interrompa e retome somente depois do checkpoint. Confira offsets 1 e 2 e a posição 130, sem repetir o crédito inicial.
observations.scope_limit: The log is a local immutable fixture. Retention, partitioned offsets, broker transactions and durable checkpoint atomicity are separate concerns.

observations.basis: Batch emits after the chosen finite input set completes; stream processing updates the result as each event arrives.
observations.action: Processe os três eventos como um lote completo e depois um por vez. Observe quando cada modelo produz uma posição e confira o mesmo total final.
observations.scope_limit: The finite input demonstrates emission semantics rather than an unbounded engine, watermark or event-time guarantee.

observations.basis: The map/group/reduce stages aggregate values per key instead of confusing all partial values with one total.
observations.action: Mapeie as ordens para pares de tipo e valor, agrupe pela chave e reduza cada grupo. Confira buy=150 e sell=20.
observations.scope_limit: This is local grouping, not a distributed shuffle, combiner or fault-tolerant MapReduce runtime.

observations.basis: Batch and speed-layer views cover disjoint input positions before being merged, preventing double counting at their boundary.
observations.action: Defina o cutoff no offset 1, mantenha o lote até esse ponto e a visão rápida somente depois dele. Compare a soma sobreposta incorreta com 80 + 50 = 130.
observations.scope_limit: The example models the Lambda view boundary, without two deployed engines, backfill orchestration or full event-time handling.

observations.basis: One retained event log and one processing path support replay and ongoing processing rather than a separate batch algorithm.
observations.action: Corrija a interpretação do débito e reexecute o mesmo processador sobre o log. Acrescente um evento e confira que a mesma lógica atende reconstrução e continuidade.
observations.scope_limit: Retention, reprocessing isolation and operational cutover of a new stream version are not implemented.

observations.basis: Local subscribers emit the next facts and a compensation handler reacts to the failure, exhibiting choreographed saga collaboration.
observations.action: Publique order-placed e deixe cada participante reagir ao fato que conhece. Observe funds-reserved, allocation-failed e compensated recomporem o saldo sem um coordenador que chame todos os passos.
observations.scope_limit: Delivery, duplicate events, distributed recovery and cycles are not solved by this in-memory choreography.

observations.basis: The caller does not await the later handler result, so its successful return does not prove eventual delivery or business completion.
observations.action: Retorne ao chamador depois de emitir a intenção e provoque a falha do worker mais tarde. Diferencie a confirmação da chamada da conclusão do trabalho.
observations.scope_limit: The outgoing queue is not durable and no delivery guarantee is claimed.

observations.basis: Multiple input streams converge into one correlated output without discarding source ownership.
observations.action: Reúna o fluxo de ordens e o de liquidações preservando a origem de cada mensagem. Confira três entradas e as duas contagens por fonte.
observations.scope_limit: The finite merge does not order independent clocks or wait for a distributed completeness barrier.

observations.basis: A persisted workflow identity and phase drive recovery after process-state loss, skipping the completed local step.
observations.action: Interrompa depois de persistir credited, feche a conexão e reabra o arquivo de progresso. Confira que a retomada executa a notificação e não repete o crédito já registrado.
observations.scope_limit: The local effects and checkpoints share SQLite transactions. External activity retries, timers, worker leasing and a full durable-workflow framework are not implemented.

observations.basis: Expiry makes the abandoned authorization reclaimable, while owner comparison prevents an old owner from releasing the new lease.
observations.action: Avance o relógio além da validade de A, deixe B adquirir a autorização e tente liberar a lease com a identidade antiga de A.
observations.scope_limit: The model uses a controlled clock; expiration is not destination fencing and does not stop an old external side effect.

observations.basis: Both participants use one atomic unique-key arbiter instead of independent local locks; ownership is checked at release.
observations.action: Use duas conexões independentes ao mesmo coordenador SQLite. Dispute a chave ORDER-1 e tente liberar a chave com o dono errado.
observations.scope_limit: SQLite is local to this machine. The experiment proves shared-arbiter coordination, not a networked lease service under partitions.

observations.basis: The writer obtains exclusion before changing the record; the second writer cannot begin its write transaction until release.
observations.action: Mantenha BEGIN IMMEDIATE aberto no primeiro escritor. Confira a recusa imediata da segunda conexão, finalize a primeira e repita a segunda escrita.
observations.scope_limit: This is SQLite database-writer exclusion, not PostgreSQL row locking or a recommendation to hold locks during network calls.

observations.basis: A writer changes a new copy instead of mutating the snapshot held by the old reader.
observations.action: Mantenha um leitor com o snapshot anterior, copie antes da escrita e altere a nova cópia. Confira que o leitor continua em 1.000 enquanto a cópia chega a 1.100.
observations.scope_limit: The fixture is a flat dictionary; deep object graphs, memory reclamation and lock-free publication require additional contracts.

observations.basis: A real asyncio semaphore bounds concurrent entry to two and releases its permits after each task.
observations.action: Execute quatro tarefas que cedem a execução enquanto seguram a permissão. Confira no máximo duas dentro da seção e quatro conclusões.
observations.scope_limit: The semaphore is local to this event loop and does not limit the producer buffer or sum capacity across processes.

observations.basis: The executor reuses two workers, forks four computations and joins their four results into one total.
observations.action: Submeta quatro tarefas a duas threads reutilizadas, aguarde as respostas e reúna os resultados parciais. Confira a quantidade de executores e o total composto.
observations.scope_limit: No process pool, distributed worker, work durability or network scatter/gather is claimed.

observations.basis: An idle worker steals eligible queued work from another worker while task ownership changes exactly once in this schedule.
observations.action: Deixe B ocioso enquanto A tem duas tarefas. Faça B retirar uma tarefa elegível da outra ponta da fila de A e confira uma execução de cada tarefa.
observations.scope_limit: The deques are manipulated sequentially; a real concurrent deque requires its own atomicity and memory-order guarantees.

observations.basis: Concurrent readers are compatible with each other and incompatible with an exclusive writer in the finite state model.
observations.action: Adquira duas leituras, tente a escrita, libere as leituras e depois tente ler durante a escrita. Confira as duas formas diferentes de exclusão.
observations.scope_limit: This is a serialized lock-state schedule, not a thread-safe RWLock implementation or a fairness proof.

observations.basis: The contender repeatedly tests the lock state without blocking, consuming execution steps while the owner is paused.
observations.action: Execute tentativas ativas enquanto a trava está ocupada e programe sua liberação depois da terceira tentativa. Conte quatro tentativas até a aquisição.
observations.scope_limit: The model uses serialized test-and-set steps, not a hardware spinlock, CPU benchmark or permission to spin while waiting for HTTP.

observations.basis: The CAS retry pattern permits system progress while one contender stalls; this schedule also shows why that is not a per-thread bounded completion guarantee.
observations.action: Faça A e B lerem o mesmo contador, deixe A ganhar o CAS e pause B depois de sua falha. Confira que A ainda consegue concluir outra operação.
observations.scope_limit: The CAS primitive is atomic by model assumption. This is a concrete progress/starvation schedule, not a universal proof for a native-memory implementation.

observations.basis: With one producer, one consumer and atomic ordered index publication, each straight-line operation returns success/full/empty in at most four modeled steps without a retry loop.
observations.action: Preencha a fila SPSC de duas posições, tente a terceira inclusão e faça três retiradas. Confira que até a recusa por cheia e o resultado vazio terminam em até quatro passos do modelo.
observations.scope_limit: The bounded-step argument belongs to this SPSC atomic-index model; Python execution time, allocation, native memory ordering and multiple producers are not covered.

observations.basis: Demand gates delivery and cancellation stops subsequent onNext-style emissions in this local publisher/subscriber contract.
observations.action: Solicite dois elementos e depois mais um. Cancele antes do quarto e confira que uma solicitação posterior não reativa a assinatura cancelada.
observations.scope_limit: No Reactive Streams library, asynchronous serialization rule or full TCK conformance is claimed.

observations.basis: Recreate produces a zero-ready interval in this schedule, while a one-at-a-time rolling replacement preserves one ready instance.
observations.action: Troque as duas instâncias encerrando todas antes de criar as novas e depois uma por vez. Conte a menor capacidade pronta de cada sequência.
observations.scope_limit: Readiness and resource capacity are assumed by the fixture; Kubernetes scheduling and actual service availability are not executed.

observations.basis: Traffic changes between two already-provisioned environments and can return to the previous ready environment.
observations.action: Mantenha blue e green prontos, altere a rota para green e volte a blue. Confira as versões visíveis e a capacidade antiga que precisou permanecer disponível.
observations.scope_limit: The route switch does not undo incompatible data written by the new environment; no deployment platform is contacted.

observations.basis: A versioned desired-state source drives the plan and reconciliation instead of allowing manual runtime drift to become the desired source.
observations.action: Selecione a revisão 2 da fonte declarativa, calcule o plano e aplique-o. Depois introduza drift manual nas réplicas e reconcilie de novo pela mesma revisão.
observations.scope_limit: The revision store is a local model, not actual Git commits, Terraform state, a cluster operator or deployment proof.

observations.basis: The new infrastructure instance is created as a replacement while the prior instance remains unchanged.
observations.action: Crie a instância 2 com a imagem nova e altere o destino ativo, preservando a instância 1. Compare isso com editar a imagem do recurso existente.
observations.scope_limit: Instance identity and images are logical fixtures, without a cloud API, image build or real infrastructure mutation.

observations.names: Branch by Abstraction|Service Extraction|Strangler Fig|Transitional Architecture
observations.basis: An abstraction preserves the caller contract while routing one extracted capability to its new owner, leaving the rest on the legacy path during transition.
observations.action: Faça o cliente usar a fachada, migre somente /orders para a implementação nova e mantenha /positions na antiga. Confira os donos chamados e o contrato observado pelo cliente.
observations.scope_limit: The services are logical functions. This does not implement independent deployment, a data migration or a transactional cutover.

observations.basis: Data is split into stores with explicit capability owners, exposing the need for an integration contract between the formerly shared consumers.
observations.action: Extraia as linhas por dono, altere o armazenamento de ordens e confira que a posição não é reescrita pelo acesso direto à mesma tabela.
observations.scope_limit: The stores are local maps; schema migrations, foreign-key removal and cross-database reconciliation are not executed.

observations.basis: An explicit directory maps an entity key to its owning shard, independently of a hash function.
observations.action: Mude a localização da chave 7 para B no diretório e resolva o dono antes de consultar. Confira que adivinhar A não encontra a posição.
observations.scope_limit: Directory durability, stale entries and live moves are not modeled.

observations.basis: Half-open ranges assign the boundary key to exactly one shard rather than overlapping owners.
observations.action: Procure a chave 100 nos intervalos 0 até antes de 100 e 100 até antes de 200. Confira que a borda pertence a um único shard.
observations.scope_limit: Range balancing, splits and hotspot control are separate concerns.

observations.basis: A geographic attribute chooses the data owner rather than a key hash.
observations.action: Use a região declarada da conta fictícia para escolher a partição e confira onde seu valor foi guardado.
observations.scope_limit: The geography is hypothetical and is not a claim about a regulatory residency rule.

observations.basis: Vertical partitions divide attributes while preserving the key needed to reconstruct the logical entity.
observations.action: Separe os atributos de contato dos atributos de posição pela mesma chave. Confira quais colunas a consulta de posição precisa ler e reuna a linha somente quando necessário.
observations.scope_limit: The example models attribute ownership and does not measure physical page savings or authorization by itself.

observations.basis: Updates append records and reads resolve the latest version, exposing the read/compaction work introduced by a log-structured representation.
observations.action: Acrescente a nova versão em vez de sobrescrever a antiga e resolva a leitura pelo registro mais recente da chave.
observations.scope_limit: This is a tiny append-log model, not an LSM tree with SSTables, bloom filters or crash recovery.

observations.basis: Coalescing repeated overwrites of one snapshot reduces physical writes before the batch acknowledgement.
observations.action: Agrupe dez substituições do mesmo snapshot de posição antes de confirmar o lote e grave o último valor uma vez. Compare as escritas físicas necessárias.
observations.scope_limit: This applies to replaceable snapshots, not ten independent ledger facts. No per-update durability is promised before the batch flush.

pending_examples.MVC: Execute a controller calling an explicit model and selecting a view, then show the differing responsibilities when the order changes.
pending_examples.MVP: Execute a presenter updating a passive view through its contract, independently of model changes.
pending_examples.MVVM: Change a view-model value and observe binding update the view, with a separate command path back to the model.
pending_examples.Read Through: Make the cache API own miss loading and show that the caller never orchestrates a source fetch or populate step.
pending_examples.Message Translator: Transform an incoming message schema into a distinct consumer schema and validate both shapes.
pending_examples.Gossip Protocol: Exchange peer state until the declared membership converges without invoking a majority decision.
pending_examples.OAuth2: Exercise a grant/token flow and resource-server validation; an unsigned expiry check does not establish it.
pending_examples.OIDC: Validate identity-token issuer, audience, signature and subject through an actual identity flow.
pending_examples.mTLS: Demonstrate peer certificate authentication and rejection of an untrusted peer certificate.
pending_examples.GraphQL Federation: Resolve one financial result through entity references across two actual subgraphs.
pending_examples.WebSocket: Demonstrate bidirectional frames and connection lifecycle; mapping a provider status cannot show this mechanism.
pending_examples.Server-Sent Events: Emit and consume ordered event-stream records, including an explicit resume or disconnect condition.
pending_examples.Value Object: Construct an immutable civil-date or monetary value, reject an invalid value and show value equality without entity identity.
pending_examples.Three-Phase Commit / 3PC: Exercise canCommit, preCommit and doCommit with the declared timing/failure assumptions, rather than showing a 2PC prepared participant alone.
pending_examples.Leader Election: Execute votes and select a particular candidate in a term; counting eligible partitions is not an election.
pending_examples.Secrets Rotation: Verify signatures before and after changing trusted signing keys, including overlap and retired-key rejection.
pending_examples.Bulkhead: Block one dependency pool while another independently budgeted pool continues to process orders.
pending_examples.Worker Pool: Assign and execute tasks across reused worker instances, observe concurrency capacity and task completion.
pending_examples.Pessimistic Locking: Hold the protected record before changing it and show a second transaction waits or is refused until release.
pending_examples.Lock-Free: Exercise an actual nonblocking algorithm and its system-progress property under the declared schedule.
pending_examples.Wait-Free: Exercise an algorithm with a stated bounded-step per-operation argument; version rejection alone does not supply that guarantee.
